newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Avmin gets 120.4 mln rand Venetia royalty.
newsitem.headline: Avmin gets 120.4 mln rand Venetia royalty.

text.p: Anglovaal Minerals Ltd (Avmin) said on Thursday it had received 120.4 million rand in respect of its share of the royalty from the Venetia diamond mine for the six months to December 31, 1996.

It said in a statement it had received the royalty from De Beers Consolidated Diamond Mines Ltd through the Saturn Partnership, in which it holds a 65.6 percent interest. Venetia's profits are shared equally between the partnership and De Beers.
Avmin said the total royalty for the period was 183.5 million rand compared with 231.1 million for the six months to June 30, 1996 and 107.9 million for the half year to December 31, 1995.
